verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents Snyk-based automatic security scanning and a separate AI code reviewer that 'suggests fixes' on PRs, but no evidence ties AI-generated fixes specifically to detected security vulnerabilities, nor shows fixes being automatically applied rather than merely suggested for human review. missing for 10: evidence of AI directly remediating security scan findings, evidence of automatic (not human-approved) application of fixes, any hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
